an10.15:1.1: Yāvatā bhikkhave sattā apadā vā dipadā vā catuppadā vā bahuppadā vā rūpino vā arūpino vā saññino vā asaññino vā nevasaññināsaññino vā, Tathāgato tesaṃ aggam akkhāyati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho:
an10.15:1.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā, appamādo tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aggam akkhāyati. 2.
an10.15:2.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave yāni kānici jaṅgalānaṃ pāṇānaṃ padajātāni, sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti, hatthipadaṃ tesaṃ aggam akkhāyati, yad idaṃ mahantattena:
an10.15:2.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā, appamādo tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aggam akkhāyati.
an10.15:3.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave kūṭāgārassa yā kāci gopānasiyo, sabbā tā kūṭaṅgamā kūṭaninnā kūṭasamosaraṇā, kūṭaṃ tāsaṃ aggam akkhāyati: evam
an10.15:3.2: eva kho bhikkhave ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā, appamādo tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aggam akkhāyati.
an10.15:4.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave ye keci mūlagandhā, kāḷānusāriyaṃ tesaṃ aggam akkhāyati: evam
an10.15:4.2: eva kho bhikkhave ye keci kusalā . . . pe . . .
an10.15:5.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave ye keci sāragandhā, lohitacandanaṃ tesaṃ aggam akkhāyati: evam
an10.15:6.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave ye keci pupphagandhā, vassikaṃ tesaṃ aggam akkhāyati: evam
an10.15:7.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave ye keci kuḍḍarājāno, sabbe te rañño cakkavattissa anuyantā bhavanti, rājā tesaṃ cakkavatti aggam akkhāyati: evam
an10.15:8.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave yā kāci tārakarūpānaṃ pabhā, sabbā tā candappabhāya kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ, candappabhā tāsaṃ aggam akkhāyati:
an10.15:9.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabhaṃ abbhussukkamāno sabbaṃ ākāsagataṃ tamagataṃ abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca:
an10.15:10.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave yā kāci mahānadiyo, seyyathīdaṃ Gaṅgā Yamunā Aciravatī Sarabhū Mahī, sabbā tā samuddaṅgamā samuddaninnā samuddapoṇā samuddapabbhārā, mahāsamuddo tāsaṃ aggam akkhāyati: evam
an10.15:10.2: eva kho bhikkhave ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā, appamādo tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aggam akkhāyatī
